title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: recovery payment amount is the lesser of the floored balance and the cross-membership ceiling
content:
Under the Corporate Wellness Partnership, the amount actually applied from a missed-payment recovery payment is the smaller of two figures: the enrollment's currently owed balance (floored at zero), and the cross-membership ceiling on a single payment transaction. Whichever of those two figures is smaller becomes the applied amount, and that applied amount is rounded to 2 decimal places.

Worked example (hypothetical): if the enrollment's floored balance were $35.00 and the cross-membership ceiling were $1200.00, the smaller of the two — $35.00 — is the amount applied. If instead the floored balance were $1600.00 and the ceiling were $1200.00, the smaller figure — $1200.00 — is the amount applied, so the remainder of that payment attempt is not applied under this rule.
